trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.location: 7470 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, US (28.3314,-81.5863)

day_by_day.morning: No activities — flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities — flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30. Collect luggage, arrange ground transportation (Uber/Lyft or hotel shuttle — confirm free shuttle availability with Ramada in advance). Check in to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Review park tickets and plan the week ahead. Pick up any essentials at a nearby 24-hour Walmart Supercenter (~5 min drive on US-192) to stock up on snacks, sunscreen, and water bottles to save money throughout the trip.

meals.breakfast: N/A — in transit
meals.lunch: N/A — in transit
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at McDonald's or Taco Bell on US-192 (open late, within 1 mile of hotel) — budget ~$8–12 per person

day_by_day.notes: Confirm the free theme park shuttle schedule with the front desk upon check-in. Purchase multi-day Disney park tickets in advance online for the best rates. Consider the Disney Dining Plan or plan to bring snacks/refillable water bottles into the parks to cut food costs significantly.

day_by_day.morning: Take the free hotel shuttle to Magic Kingdom — arrive at park opening (typically 9:00 AM). Head straight to Fantasyland to ride Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and Peter Pan's Flight using the Lightning Lane or early arrival strategy. Explore Cinderella Castle and grab a photo. Ride The Haunted Mansion and Pirates of the Caribbean in Liberty Square and Adventureland.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom — ride Big Thunder Mountain Railroad in Frontierland and Space Mountain in Tomorrowland. Watch the Festival of Fantasy Parade (check daily schedule). Take a break during peak heat hours (1–3 PM) at an air-conditioned attraction like Walt Disney's Carousel of Progress or the PeopleMover.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Magic Kingdom Fireworks (Happily Ever After — check schedule, typically 9:00 PM). This is a bucket-list moment and completely included with park admission. Take the hotel shuttle back after the show.

meals.breakfast: Eat a hearty breakfast at the hotel before leaving — pack granola bars and fruit from your Walmart haul to save money
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — budget-friendly counter service with sandwiches and clam chowder (~$12–15 per person)
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — one of Magic Kingdom's most affordable counter-service spots with burgers, chicken, and salads (~$12–16 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable shoes and bring a refillable water bottle — free water is available at any quick-service location. Download the My Disney Experience app to check wait times and grab Lightning Lane passes. Arrive at the park 30 minutes before official opening for 'rope drop' to maximize ride time with shorter queues.

day_by_day.morning: Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT — arrive at rope drop (typically 9:00 AM). Head to World Discovery to ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane — plan ahead). Then ride Test Track and Mission: SPACE. Explore the stunning new World Celebration area and the iconic geodesic Spaceship Earth.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon exploring EPCOT's World Showcase — walk through the international pavilions (Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, UK, Canada). Ride Frozen Ever After in the Norway Pavilion and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France Pavilion. Enjoy free cultural entertainment and street performers throughout the showcase.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check schedule — typically 9:00 PM). This is a stunning fireworks and projection show included with admission. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the hotel or pack snacks from your Walmart supplies before heading out
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land Pavilion — one of EPCOT's best value quick-service restaurants with diverse options including Asian noodles, rotisserie chicken, and sandwiches (~$12–15 per person)
meals.dinner: Katsura Grill in the Japan Pavilion — affordable Japanese counter service with sushi, udon, and teriyaki (~$13–17 per person). Alternatively, grab a crepe from the France Pavilion kiosk as a lighter budget option (~$7–9)

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is a large park — comfortable walking shoes are essential. The World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so plan World Discovery and World Nature rides for the morning. If traveling with young children, prioritize Frozen Ever After and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure early before lines build.

day_by_day.morning: Take the hotel shuttle to Hollywood Studios — arrive at rope drop (typically 9:00 AM). Head immediately to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge to ride Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive rides — virtual queue or Lightning Lane required, set up at 7:00 AM on the app). Then ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Explore the incredible Star Wars land theming.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Toy Story Land to ride Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Then experience The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith in Sunset Boulevard. Watch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular (check show times — free with admission and very entertaining).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for Fantasmic! — the spectacular nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater (check schedule, typically 8:00 or 9:00 PM). Arrive 45–60 minutes early for good seating. This is a must-see included with park admission. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the hotel or bring snacks — pack a light breakfast to eat on the shuttle
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — one of Hollywood Studios' most affordable and fun counter-service spots with grilled cheese, BBQ brisket melts, and totchos (~$11–14 per person)
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary — a large, air-conditioned quick-service restaurant with burgers, chicken sandwiches, and wraps (~$12–15 per person). Great for cooling down in the evening heat

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is one of Disney's most popular parks — arriving at rope drop is critical. Lightning Lane Multi Pass is worth considering for this park given the high demand for top attractions. Bring a portable phone charger as the My Disney Experience app will drain your battery quickly.

day_by_day.morning: Take the hotel shuttle to Disney's Animal Kingdom — arrive at rope drop (typically 8:00 AM, often the earliest opening park). Head straight to Pandora – The World of Avatar to ride Avatar Flight of Passage (the park's most popular ride — lines can exceed 2 hours by 9:30 AM). Then ride Na'vi River Journey in Pandora.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa — ride Kilimanjaro Safaris (best in the morning or late afternoon for active animals). Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for free wildlife viewing. Head to Asia to ride Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (you will get wet — plan accordingly). Watch the Festival of the Lion King show in Africa (check times — spectacular and free with admission).
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Rivers of Light nighttime show or Tree of Life Awakenings (check current schedule — the Tree of Life projections are magical and free). Enjoy the park's unique atmosphere as it transitions to evening. Return to hotel via shuttle. Consider a relaxed evening at the hotel pool to rest tired feet.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the hotel before departure — Animal Kingdom opens early so an early start is key
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — widely considered one of Disney's best quick-service restaurants with smoked ribs, pulled pork, and chicken at reasonable prices (~$13–17 per person). Beautiful outdoor seating overlooking the water
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — Animal Kingdom's most popular quick-service with healthy grain bowls, noodle bowls, and cheeseburger pods (~$13–16 per person). Unique and delicious

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active on the safari. Bring a change of clothes or a poncho if riding Kali River Rapids. The park can close earlier than other Disney parks — check hours in advance. Sunscreen is especially important here as much of the park is outdoors with limited shade.

day_by_day.morning: Rest morning — sleep in and enjoy the hotel amenities (pool, breakfast). This is a planned recovery day for tired feet and bodies. Head to the nearby Old Town Kissimmee (free admission, ~5 min drive or rideshare from hotel) — a retro-themed entertainment complex with free walking, shops, and street entertainment on US-192.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the International Drive area or US-192 corridor for budget-friendly entertainment. Visit the Kissimmee Lakefront Park (free) for a relaxing walk along Lake Tohopekaliga with beautiful views. Alternatively, visit the nearby Celebration Town Center — a charming planned community with free walking, waterfront views, and window shopping. Or spend the afternoon at the hotel pool to recharge.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Disney Springs (free admission, free parking or take a rideshare) — Disney's massive outdoor shopping, dining, and entertainment complex. Enjoy free live music, street performers, and the incredible atmosphere. Browse the World of Disney store, LEGO store, and unique shops. Watch the free outdoor entertainment.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the hotel or a nearby diner — try Perkins Restaurant & Bakery on US-192 for a classic American breakfast (~$10–14 per person)
meals.lunch: Grab lunch at a local Kissimmee restaurant — Azteca D'Oro Mexican Restaurant on US-192 offers generous portions at great prices (~$10–13 per person)
meals.dinner: Disney Springs dining — try D-Luxe Burger for gourmet burgers at moderate prices (~$14–18 per person) or grab food from the various food trucks and kiosks for a more budget-friendly option (~$10–13 per person)

day_by_day.notes: This rest day is strategically placed to prevent burnout before the final park day. Disney Springs is completely free to enter and offers a great Disney atmosphere without park ticket costs. Use this day to do laundry if needed, recharge devices, and review any remaining park priorities for Day 7.

day_by_day.morning: Final park day — choose your favorite park to revisit or any park you feel you missed highlights at. Recommended: return to Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for any missed attractions. Alternatively, use this day to revisit your single favorite park from the week. Arrive at rope drop to maximize your final day. Focus on any must-do rides you missed or want to experience again.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue enjoying your chosen park. Use any remaining Lightning Lane passes or virtual queue opportunities. Pick up any last-minute souvenirs — note that the best value Disney souvenirs are often found at the park gift shops at the end of the day or at Disney Springs where prices can be slightly lower. Consider a pressed penny souvenir (~$1) as an affordable keepsake.
day_by_day.evening: Final evening at Disney — stay for the nighttime spectacular at your chosen park (fireworks at Magic Kingdom or EPCOT are the most spectacular). Enjoy a final Disney dinner. Return to hotel via shuttle. Pack bags for departure and reflect on an incredible week. Check out details with the front desk.

meals.breakfast: Final hotel breakfast — eat well before the park to fuel the last big day
meals.lunch: Revisit your favorite quick-service restaurant from the week, or try something new you noticed but didn't get to try
meals.dinner: Splurge slightly on the final night if budget allows — consider a slightly nicer counter-service option or a character dining experience if pre-booked (Be Our Guest Restaurant lunch is a moderate splurge at ~$25–30 per person but a memorable experience). Otherwise, enjoy a final meal at a favorite quick-service spot (~$12–16 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Check hotel checkout time and arrange transportation to the airport in advance. Orlando International Airport recommends arriving 2–3 hours before domestic flights and 3 hours before international flights. Uber/Lyft from Kissimmee to MCO typically costs $25–40. Budget tip: throughout the week, refillable resort mugs, bringing your own snacks, and eating a big hotel breakfast daily can save $20–40 per day per family — potentially $150–280+ in total food savings over the trip.

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight arrives at 10:30 PM. No morning activities scheduled.
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – In transit. Flight UA lands at Orlando International Airport at 10:30 PM.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 10:30 PM. Collect luggage, arrange ground transportation (Mears Connect shuttle or rideshare ~$25–$35) to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and review the week's park plans. Grab a light snack from the hotel vending area or a nearby 24-hour convenience store.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before departure.
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport.
meals.dinner: Quick bite at Orlando International Airport (The Polite Pig Express or McDonald's airside) before baggage claim, or a convenience snack at the hotel upon arrival.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Disney park tickets online in advance if not already done. Download the My Disney Experience app and link your tickets. Set up Lightning Lane Multi Pass for the next day. The hotel offers a free theme park shuttle — check the front desk for the next morning's schedule. Get to bed early to maximize Day 2.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure – Start early! Take the hotel's free theme park shuttle (departs ~8:00 AM). Arrive at Magic Kingdom before park opening (typically 9:00 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain, then Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (use Lightning Lane if available). Ride Peter Pan's Flight and 'it's a small world' before crowds build.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom. After lunch, experience Big Thunder Mountain Railroad in Frontierland, Haunted Mansion in Liberty Square, and Pirates of the Caribbean in Adventureland. Use Lightning Lane selections strategically. Take a mid-afternoon break at the hotel if needed (shuttle runs periodically) or find a shaded spot in the park to recharge.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening. Watch the Main Street Electrical Parade and the spectacular Happily Ever After fireworks show (check app for exact times, usually 9:00 PM). Soak in the magic of Main Street USA lit up at night before heading back on the shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Quick-service breakfast at the hotel or grab a pastry and coffee at Main Street Bakery (Starbucks) inside Magic Kingdom upon arrival (~$10–$15 per person).
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square – excellent mid-range quick-service with clam chowder, lobster rolls, and fried fish (~$15–$20 per person).
meals.dinner: Skipper Canteen in Adventureland – table-service restaurant with fun theming and globally inspired dishes (~$20–$35 per person). Book via My Disney Experience app in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, hats, and refillable water bottles. June in Orlando is hot and humid (highs ~92°F/33°C) with afternoon thunderstorms possible — pack a small poncho. Arrive at the bus stop 15 minutes before shuttle departure. Purchase a refillable resort mug if the hotel offers one.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience – Take the hotel shuttle to Hollywood Studios (opens ~9:00 AM). Head directly to Galaxy's Edge upon entry. Book a time slot for Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run via the app. If budget allows, pre-book Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber ($249.99 per lightsaber — optional splurge). Explore Black Spire Outpost, interact with characters, and try Blue or Green Milk from the Milk Stand.
day_by_day.afternoon: Experience Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive rides — use Lightning Lane Individual). Then explore the rest of Hollywood Studios: Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash, Alien Swirling Saucers), Rock 'n' Roller Coaster, and The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror. Catch an Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show (check schedule on app).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the nighttime spectacular — Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular (projected light show on the Chinese Theatre, check app for times). Alternatively, catch Fantasmic! the outdoor water and fire show (separate Lightning Lane purchase recommended). Head back to the hotel via shuttle after the show.

meals.breakfast: Grab-and-go from hotel continental breakfast or a quick stop at Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge for a themed breakfast item (~$12–$18).
meals.lunch: Ronto Roasters in Galaxy's Edge – famous Ronto Wraps with roasted pork and grilled sausage (~$13–$16). Eat while exploring the land.
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant – unique drive-in movie themed table-service restaurant with burgers, sandwiches, and milkshakes (~$20–$35 per person). Book in advance on My Disney Experience.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop requires advance reservations (book 60 days out via Disney website). Rise of the Resistance is extremely popular — join the virtual queue or purchase Lightning Lane Individual as soon as the park opens. Fantasmic! requires a separate dining package or Lightning Lane purchase for guaranteed seating.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour – Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT (opens ~9:00 AM). Start in Future World (now called World Discovery/World Nature/World Celebration): ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane Individual — join immediately upon park open), Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France pavilion, and Test Track. Explore the stunning new Moana-themed Journey of Water walking trail.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition to World Showcase when it opens at 11:00 AM. Walk the 1.2-mile promenade around World Showcase Lagoon. Sample food and drinks from multiple pavilions: Mexico (fresh guacamole and margaritas), Japan (sushi and mochi), Morocco (hummus and shawarma), France (crêpes), and Canada (Le Cellier cheddar cheese soup). Catch a live cultural performance — check the app for show schedules at each pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check current show schedule on app — typically 9:00 PM). Find a spot along the lagoon 30–45 minutes early for the best view. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion – fresh, affordable quick-service with sandwiches, salads, and hot breakfast items (~$10–$15).
meals.lunch: World Showcase food stalls and kiosks – budget $20–$30 per person to graze through 3–4 countries. Try the School Bread from Norway, Beef Gyoza from Japan, and a Frozen Margarita from Mexico.
meals.dinner: Via Napoli Ristorante e Pizzeria in the Italy pavilion – authentic Neapolitan wood-fired pizza in a beautiful setting (~$20–$35 per person). Reserve in advance on My Disney Experience.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is the most 'adult-friendly' park but kids love Remy's Ratatouille Adventure and Frozen Ever After (Norway pavilion). The International Food & Wine Festival runs June–November — if active during your visit, there will be additional food booths around the lagoon (extra budget recommended: $30–$50 for tastings). Wear comfortable walking shoes — World Showcase is a long walk.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience – Take the hotel shuttle to Animal Kingdom (opens ~8:00 AM, sometimes earlier). Arrive at rope drop and head straight to Pandora – The World of Avatar. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage first (most popular ride in the park — Lightning Lane Individual highly recommended). Then experience Na'vi River Journey for a gentler, visually stunning boat ride through bioluminescent rainforest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Africa for Kilimanjaro Safaris — book a Lightning Lane or go early afternoon when animals are still active. See lions, elephants, giraffes, hippos, and more on this 18-minute open-air safari. Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail on foot. Then visit Asia for Expedition Everest roller coaster and Kali River Rapids (you WILL get wet — great on a hot June day). Check the schedule for Festival of the Lion King show in Africa.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the Rivers of Light nighttime show if available (check current schedule). Alternatively, explore Discovery Island and DinoLand U.S.A. before park close. Return to hotel via shuttle. Consider a relaxing evening at the hotel pool to rest tired feet.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at the hotel or Tiffins Road (quick-service near park entrance) upon arrival (~$10–$14).
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora – one of Disney's best quick-service restaurants with healthy grain bowls, cheeseburger pods, and unique beverages (~$15–$20 per person).
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia – table-service with Asian fusion cuisine including Mandarin chicken, pot stickers, and ahi tuna (~$20–$35 per person). Reserve in advance, or try the Yak & Yeti Local Food Cafes quick-service next door for a budget-friendly option (~$12–$18).

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks (around 8:00–9:00 PM). The park is very large — wear your most comfortable shoes. Kali River Rapids will soak you — bring a change of clothes or wear quick-dry clothing. The Pandora area is breathtaking at night with bioluminescent lighting, so try to stay until dusk if the park is open late enough.

day_by_day.morning: Rest & Resort Morning – Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely morning. Take advantage of the hotel pool (Ramada Kissimmee has outdoor pool facilities). This is a great day to do laundry, recharge devices, review photos, and purchase any remaining souvenirs from nearby shops. Alternatively, visit a nearby grocery store (Publix ~2 miles away) to stock up on snacks and drinks for the remaining days.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Afternoon – Take the hotel shuttle or a rideshare (~$10–$15) to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket required). Explore the four neighborhoods: The Landing, Marketplace, Town Center, and West Side. Visit the LEGO Store, World of Disney (largest Disney merchandise store), and browse unique boutiques. Kids can enjoy the LEGO Fountain play area. Check out the Splitsville Luxury Lanes for bowling (~$15–$20 per person) or catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Evening – Enjoy live entertainment from street performers and musicians throughout Disney Springs. Watch the sunset over the lake from The Landing waterfront. Browse the unique dining options and entertainment venues. Return to hotel by 9:00–10:00 PM for an early night before the final park day.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or cook simple items if your room has a kitchenette. Alternatively, IHOP or Denny's nearby on US-192 (~$10–$15 per person).
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs – gourmet burgers with creative toppings in a quick-service setting (~$15–$20 per person). Or grab food from multiple quick-service spots and eat by the waterfront.
meals.dinner: The Boathouse at Disney Springs – upscale-casual waterfront dining with fresh seafood, steaks, and classic American fare. Amphicar tours available from the dock (~$30–$55 per person for dinner). Reserve in advance. Budget-friendly alternative: Chicken Guy! by Guy Fieri (~$12–$18 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and a great way to experience Disney magic without a park ticket. Saturday can be crowded — arrive by 2:00 PM to get parking or secure a rideshare drop-off. The area is open until 11:00 PM. This is the best day to purchase final souvenirs as prices are the same as in the parks. Check the Disney Springs website for any special events or live performances scheduled.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom or EPCOT Return Visit / Flex Day – Use this final full day to revisit your favorite park or catch any rides/experiences you missed earlier in the week. Magic Kingdom is recommended for a final morning — arrive at rope drop for shorter wait times on Sunday mornings. Prioritize any must-do rides you didn't get to earlier. Alternatively, use this as a flex day to explore a non-Disney attraction nearby: Kennedy Space Center (~1 hour east, $75/adult) or LEGOLAND Florida (~45 minutes west, $109/adult) if the family wants variety.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final park exploration or return to the hotel for pool time and packing. If staying at a park, use the afternoon for any last Lightning Lane selections and character meet-and-greets. Visit the park gift shop for final souvenir purchases. Check out of the hotel room by the posted checkout time (typically 11:00 AM) — ask the front desk about luggage storage if your flight is later.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner near the hotel on US-192 (International Drive area has many options). Pack remaining belongings, confirm transportation to the airport for departure. Reflect on an incredible week at Walt Disney World!

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the hotel or a quick-service option inside the park upon arrival. Be's Restaurant at the hotel or a nearby Cracker Barrel on US-192 (~$10–$15 per person).
meals.lunch: Inside the park: Casey's Corner on Main Street USA at Magic Kingdom for classic hot dogs and corn dog nuggets (~$12–$16 per person), or a World Showcase pavilion at EPCOT.
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at Olive Garden or LongHorn Steakhouse on US-192 (both within 2 miles of hotel, ~$20–$35 per person) for a relaxed, budget-friendly final meal. Or splurge at Charley's Steak House on International Drive (~$40–$60 per person) for a memorable send-off.

day_by_day.notes: Check hotel checkout time and arrange airport transportation in advance (Mears Connect, rideshare, or rental car return). Orlando International Airport recommends arriving 2.5–3 hours before domestic flights and 3+ hours for international. Keep one day's worth of comfortable clothes accessible for travel home. Save digital copies of all park photos via the My Disney Experience app (PhotoPass if purchased). Consider purchasing a Disney Memory Maker package ($199) at the start of the trip for unlimited digital photos taken by Disney photographers throughout all parks.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Disney World, Orlando, Florida Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway - Free Theme Park Shuttle
hotel.location: 7470 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, US (28.3314,-81.5863)

experiences.name: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure
experiences.description: Spend a full day at the iconic Magic Kingdom, riding classics like Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and the Haunted Mansion. Watch the Festival of Fantasy parade and end the night with the spectacular Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle.
experiences.best_time_of_day: Morning (arrive at rope drop) through Evening
experiences.location: Magic Kingdom, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience
experiences.description: Immerse your family in the Star Wars universe at Galaxy's Edge. Build your own lightsaber at Savi's Workshop, pilot the Millennium Falcon on Smugglers Run, and experience the thrilling Rise of the Resistance ride. Enjoy themed food and drinks at Oga's Cantina.
experiences.location: Hollywood Studios, Galaxy's Edge, Walt Disney World Resort

experiences.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
experiences.description: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase, sampling authentic cuisine and experiencing cultural pavilions from 11 countries including France, Japan, Morocco, and Mexico. Enjoy live entertainment, artisan demonstrations, and the stunning EPCOT Forever nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon.
experiences.location: EPCOT World Showcase, Walt Disney World Resort

experiences.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience
experiences.description: Embark on the Kilimanjaro Safaris to see real African wildlife including lions, elephants, and giraffes. Then journey to Pandora – The World of Avatar for the breathtaking Flight of Passage ride and the magical Na'vi River Journey, especially stunning after dark when bioluminescent plants glow.
experiences.best_time_of_day: Early Morning for Safari, Evening for Pandora
experiences.location: Disney's Animal Kingdom, Pandora – The World of Avatar, Walt Disney World Resort

experiences.name: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Evening
experiences.description: Spend a fun-filled evening at Disney Springs exploring unique shops, world-class dining, and live entertainment. Enjoy dinner at The BOATHOUSE or T-REX Cafe, catch a show at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater, and let kids experience the interactive fountain play area. No park ticket required.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives late night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — flight arrives late night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via Flight UA. Use the hotel's complimentary theme park shuttle or arrange a private car transfer to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and settle into your room. Grab a light late-night snack from the hotel or a nearby 24-hour spot.

meals.breakfast: On the flight or at the airport
meals.lunch: On the flight or at the airport
meals.dinner: Late-night snack at the hotel or nearby — try Denny's (open 24 hrs, 2 min drive) or room service if available

day_by_day.notes: Arrival is at 22:30, so no park activities are scheduled. Prioritize rest for the big days ahead. Pre-download the My Disney Experience app and link your park tickets tonight if possible. Confirm park reservations and Genie+ selections for Day 2.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure — Arrive at rope drop (park opens ~9:00 AM). Take the hotel's free theme park shuttle (departs ~8:00 AM). Start with Tomorrowland: ride Space Mountain and TRON Lightcycle Run using Lightning Lane early. Head to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Magic Kingdom exploration — Enjoy Big Thunder Mountain Railroad in Frontierland, Pirates of the Caribbean, and the Haunted Mansion. Grab Lightning Lane passes for top rides via Genie+. Take a midday break at the hotel or a shaded area in the park to avoid peak heat.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Magic Kingdom nighttime spectacular — Watch the 'Disney Enchantment' fireworks show and the Main Street Electrical Parade. Secure a premium viewing spot near the Hub Grass area in front of Cinderella Castle at least 45 minutes early.

meals.breakfast: The Wave... of American Flavors at Disney's Contemporary Resort — upscale breakfast buffet with seasonal American cuisine (book via OpenTable in advance)
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant inside Magic Kingdom — dine in the enchanted Beast's Castle; order the French-inspired prix fixe lunch menu
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table inside Cinderella Castle — a once-in-a-lifetime fine dining experience with princess character meet-and-greets; book 60 days in advance

day_by_day.notes: Book all Magic Kingdom dining 60 days in advance via the My Disney Experience app. Purchase Genie+ ($35–$45/person/day) and individual Lightning Lane selections for TRON and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, hats, and a portable fan for the June heat.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience — Take the shuttle for early park entry (~8:30 AM). Head straight to Galaxy's Edge. Book a Savi's Workshop Lightsaber Building experience (reserve in advance, ~$259/person) — a deeply immersive, premium Star Wars ritual.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore more of Hollywood Studios — Ride Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (Lightning Lane a must), Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run, and Slinky Dog Dash in Toy Story Land. Visit the Droid Depot to build a custom droid (~$119.99). Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the 'Fantasmic!' nighttime show at Hollywood Studios — an epic outdoor spectacular featuring Mickey Mouse, Disney villains, and stunning water/fire effects. Arrive 60–90 minutes early for premium seating. Optionally add the Fantasmic! Dining Package for guaranteed reserved seating.

meals.breakfast: Roundup Rodeo BBQ at Toy Story Land — a whimsical, immersive Toy Story-themed breakfast experience (book in advance)
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge — themed quick-service with creative, out-of-this-world dishes; try the Smoked Kaadu Ribs
meals.dinner: Hollywood Brown Derby — the park's signature fine dining restaurant inspired by the legendary 1930s Hollywood hotspot; try the iconic Cobb Salad and prime steaks

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop and Droid Depot reservations must be made well in advance — these sell out months ahead. The Fantasmic! Dining Package (~$55–$75/adult) includes a meal at select restaurants plus guaranteed Fantasmic! seating. Bring a light jacket for the evening show as it can get breezy near the water.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Arrive at EPCOT for early entry (~8:30 AM). Start with Future World: ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue — join at park open) and Test Track. Then transition to the World Showcase as it opens at 11:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: Deep dive into EPCOT's World Showcase — Sample authentic cuisine and drinks from pavilions including France, Japan, Morocco, Italy, and Canada. Participate in the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival activities if running (typically June–November). Ride Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France Pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Conclude the day with EPCOT's 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Harmonious' nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon — one of the largest nighttime shows ever created at Disney. Watch from the Italy or Germany pavilion for a stunning lakeside view.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons at The Land Pavilion — fresh, healthy breakfast options in a bright, airy setting inside EPCOT
meals.lunch: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion — premium teppanyaki-style dining with skilled chefs cooking tableside; reserve 60 days ahead
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul in the France Pavilion — EPCOT's most upscale restaurant, offering classic French haute cuisine with stunning lagoon views; Michelin-quality experience

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase is a food lover's paradise — budget extra for food booth tastings (~$5–$12 per item). The Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind virtual queue is free but fills instantly at park open — have the app ready. Monsieur Paul requires advance dining reservations and is considered one of the best restaurants on Disney property.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience — Arrive at rope drop (~8:00 AM). Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar: ride Avatar Flight of Passage (Lightning Lane essential — one of Disney's most popular rides) and Na'vi River Journey.
day_by_day.afternoon: Kilimanjaro Safaris — embark on the iconic open-air safari vehicle tour through the African savanna to see lions, elephants, giraffes, rhinos, and more. Visit the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close wildlife encounters. Catch the 'Festival of the Lion King' live show — a Broadway-caliber performance.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a relaxed evening at the resort — After a full day of walking and wildlife, return to the hotel for a swim and downtime. Alternatively, take the shuttle to Disney Springs for a leisurely evening stroll and entertainment.

meals.breakfast: Tusker House Restaurant at Animal Kingdom — Donald Duck's Safari Breakfast character dining with African-inspired cuisine; a fun, premium character experience
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora – The World of Avatar — creative, healthy bowls with alien-inspired ingredients in a stunning bioluminescent setting
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant at Animal Kingdom — upscale pan-Asian cuisine in an elaborately themed lodge setting; try the Kobe beef or crispy honey chicken

day_by_day.notes: Avatar Flight of Passage is the #1 most sought-after Lightning Lane at Animal Kingdom — purchase individual Lightning Lane access the moment the park opens. The Kilimanjaro Safari experience is best in the morning when animals are most active. Bring insect repellent for the outdoor trails.

day_by_day.morning: Return to Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for any missed experiences — Use this flexible morning to revisit favorite rides, complete any unfinished Lightning Lane experiences, or explore areas you didn't have time for earlier in the week. Alternatively, visit Disney's Typhoon Lagoon water park for a refreshing splash day (separate ticket required).
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Family Entertainment — Arrive at Disney Springs (~2:00 PM). Explore the unique shopping district: visit the LEGO Store, World of Disney (largest Disney merchandise store), and Art of Disney gallery. Enjoy the free live entertainment on the waterfront stages.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Evening — Dine at one of Disney Springs' world-class restaurants and enjoy the vibrant nightlife atmosphere. Catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 Theatre or enjoy a live performance. This is a perfect, relaxed final full evening before departure prep.

meals.breakfast: In-room or hotel breakfast — enjoy a leisurely morning meal at the hotel before heading out
meals.lunch: The Boathouse at Disney Springs — upscale waterfront dining featuring fresh seafood, prime steaks, and stunning views of the Springs; try the lobster bisque and fresh oysters
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia at Disney Springs — Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship pan-Asian restaurant; an extraordinary fine dining experience with sushi, Peking duck, and innovative Asian fusion dishes

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter with no park ticket required — perfect for a lower-key day. The Boathouse also offers unique amphicar tours on the water (~$125 for 20 minutes) — a fun, premium family experience. Make dinner reservations at Morimoto Asia well in advance as it is extremely popular.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning at leisure — Enjoy a relaxed breakfast at the hotel. Do any last-minute souvenir shopping at the hotel gift shop or a quick trip to Disney Springs if time allows. Pack and prepare for checkout. Confirm airport transfer or shuttle arrangements.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway and transfer to Orlando International Airport. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for check-in, security, and boarding. Enjoy a final Florida meal at the airport.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Orlando — carry magical memories of an extraordinary Disney World luxury experience.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or nearby — try Keke's Breakfast Cafe (5 min drive, highly rated local breakfast spot) for a final Florida-style morning meal
meals.lunch: Orlando International Airport — dine at The Hemisphere Restaurant (airside) or grab premium options from the airport's upscale food hall
meals.dinner: In-flight or at destination

day_by_day.notes: Check out time is typically 11:00 AM — request a late checkout (12:00–1:00 PM) if your flight is in the afternoon. Store luggage with the hotel concierge if needed for a few extra hours. Purchase any final Disney merchandise at the airport's Disney store in the terminal. Consider a private car service for a stress-free airport transfer on departure day.

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June
